community.evidence: promote healthier populations in local communities

innovation.evidence: We are committed to introducing innovative approaches, products and services

result.analyst_notes: Corporate, third-person voice ('UnitedHealth Group') with one first-person-plural commitment ('We are committed to'). Opening is aspirational ('a leader worldwide'), but most content is factual scale statistics (140 countries, 325,000 people, 1.1 trillion transactions). Stakeholder focus is health-system and community first, with innovation next. Commitments are hedged ('can improve'). No governance, environment or safety values stated.
